exports.name: BreakpointName
exports.description:
Breakpoint names accepted by responsive props (besides `base`): the configured names when the
generated declarations are part of the program, otherwise the defaults `sm md lg xl 2xl`.
The conditional type replaces the whole union, so `replace` mode removes the default names.
exports.definition: BreakpointRegistry extends { readonly names: infer Names extends string; } ? Names : DefaultBreakpointName

exports.name: BreakpointRegistry
BreakpointWidth
exports.description: A breakpoint threshold in `rem`, e.g. `"48rem"`. Checked by the `neshel` CLI.

exports.name: BreakpointsInput
exports.description: Consumer-defined responsive breakpoints (feature 004, contracts/breakpoints.md).

props.name: mode
props.description: `extend` keeps the defaults (sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl) and adds names; `replace` uses only `values`.

props.name: tailwind
props.description: Also emit Tailwind CSS v4 `@theme` breakpoints in the generated stylesheet.

props.name: values
props.description: Name → `min-width` threshold. Names: lower camelCase (`phoneXL`); widths: distinct `rem`.

exports.name: ColorRole
exports.description: One of the 25 semantic colour roles, in canonical order (see `colorRoles`).

exports.name: ColorValue
exports.description:
A CSS colour: `#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb()`, `rgba()`, `hsl()`, `hsla()`
or `oklch()`. Only `border` may be translucent. Checked by the `neshel` CLI, not by types.

exports.name: ContrastPair
exports.description: A foreground/background pair whose contrast is checked.

props.name: minimum
props.description: Minimum WCAG 2.1 ratio, or `null` for a documented exemption.

exports.name: ContrastPolicy
exports.description: How contrast failures of custom themes are reported. `neshel --strict` always means "error".

exports.name: DefaultBreakpointName
exports.description: Default breakpoint names, ascending: sm 40rem, md 48rem, lg 64rem, xl 80rem, 2xl 96rem.

exports.name: ExactConfig
exports.description:
Compile-time exactness for `defineConfig`: unknown keys at any level, named themes without
`extends`, `extends` on `light`/`dark`, and a `system` theme become type errors.

exports.name: FontMetrics
exports.description:
Font metrics in Capsize's format (objects from `@capsizecss/metrics` can be passed directly).
Used by `neshel generate` for cap-height sizing and trimming (feature 004).

props.description: Average character width; required for fallback font generation.

exports.name: defineConfig
exports.description:
Declare a Neshel-UI configuration with type checking and editor completion. Returns its
argument unchanged; colour, length and theme-name contents are validated by `neshel validate`.
